svg.title: Green Lantern power battery - fluid path and layout, true section at x = 0
svg.text: Fluid path and layout — section through the centre, seen from the side
Rev C, drawn from the CAD (cad/output); 1.5 px = 1 mm. Audience (front lens) on the left, your side (the hand bell) on the right. Tube route approximate.
emblem lid on a white halo ring; 2 LED
strips on the cap wall light it
cap floor: battery, board, buck,
power switch, charge socket (lid off)
front bell: LED ring behind the
frosted lens (audience side)
white LED panel: 4 rows on its front,
hides the spout and the glass
lock wall: the lock on its face,
the spout hidden behind it
spout behind the wall: the tube
pours into the back third of the glass
glass slot: push the glass back
to the stop (a ridge clicks it in)
foot: the slot hangs in its neck;
tube and pump wires pass up
pump wires: one plug, up to the cap
Kamoer KPHM200 pump (behind
the section), head toward your side
lock, LED and pump leads run up
behind the wall to plugs at the cap floor
one-piece frosted cover: 8 flaps
fold round your arm, spring shut
your fist, punched in; the ring
face sits in the lock; LED ring
in the hand bell
to take the glass: grip its front,
1 slide it toward you 29 mm
2 lift it clear of the slot
3 bring it out through the cover
glass rim 3 mm under the lock
32 oz drink bag under its cover; tube
tip clipped in the well, then through
the pump (behind the section) and up
cartridge: twist the lantern and
lift it off to refill
drink
cables
printed, cut
behind the cut
50 mm
